answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 44236 Country: India Title: Dream Question: My daughter aged 24 years has been seeing lizards in her dream repeatedly for past many nights in the later part of the night. I shall be thankful, if this dream can be interpreted. Answer ID: 44236 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 392/307/B=1434) Ask your daughter to recite 4 Quls before going to bed. In-shaAllah, she shall be saved from such dreams. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
